'''Typhoeus''' (Greek: Τυφωεύς; Swedish: /tʏˈfoː.ɛvs/; short form: '''Typh''' /tʏf/) is a 6★ [[Nature]] [[Striker]] [[Operator]] from [[Rhodes Island]] who excels at attacking enemies from afar. She is an [[Arts Unit]] user. Using her battle skill and ultimate, she can enter a Hovering status. While hovering, she consumes Hunting Arrows to empower her shots, frequently hitting enemies with Arts Bursts to deal massive Burst DMG.

{{Quote|Dags att välja vårt byte. (Time to choose our prey.)}}

==Profile==
"A good story is like a good hunter. Both aim straight for the heart."

Typhoeus, huntress of the wilds from Rhodes Island, is curious about the world. She is eager to delve into uninhabited and unexplored places to
uncover the forgotten past. 

On Talos-II, many legends of Sami have already faded, and only a handful of Samifjod still remember them. Typhoeus has resolved to visit them one by one, recording those shattered memories in her notebook.

After arriving at Endfield, the stories she pursued were no longer confined to forgotten legends. She met many new friends and exchanged
stories with people from across the land. And in pursuing those legends, she is also writing a story of her own.

One day, when every page of her notebook has been filled, she will proclaim to the friends around her: "Legends aren't always too far off... They can happen right next to us."
